fichas.title: Maternity unit and delivery suite
fichas.summary: The maternity unit accommodates normal births and complications, with delivery rooms and provision for caesarean births in or near a theatre. It should connect to post-natal and baby-care areas. The delivery suite includes space for midwives and observation, labour and delivery rooms, and staff and patient support spaces.
furniture_equipment: Changing table with integrated baby bath
figure_refs: 1 — Maternity/birth assistance, St Elisabeth Hospital, Halle

fichas.title: Radiotherapy department
fichas.summary: Radiotherapy departments require treatment rooms with changing facilities for ambulant patients and waiting space for bedbound patients, alongside clinical, technical, and support rooms. Radiation protection is provided by lead inserts or thick concrete walls. Heavy equipment and shielding favor basement or ground-floor locations. Figures show linear-accelerator and radiotherapy department layouts.
